info.title: Scarlet.Tailwind.Cli - Tailwind CSS as a .NET Tool
info.description: Run the Tailwind CSS standalone CLI as a .NET tool: `dotnet tailwind --input app.css --output wwwroot/css/app.css`. No Node.js required. Platform-specific packages embed the matching Tailwind binary, so `dotnet tool restore` works offline and pins Tailwind through .config/dotnet-tools.json - no download, no network, hash-verified by NuGet. Every argument is forwarded to Tailwind verbatim.
